title: Pan-Seared Trout with Moroccan Amlou Sauce
description: A delicate trout dish served with a rich and nutty amlou sauce, inspired by the flavors of Morocco.

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: use a high-quality oil with a distinct flavor

instructions: 1. In a small bowl, mix together the exotic spice blend, garlic, and lemon juice.
2. Season the trout fillet with salt and pepper to taste.
3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
4. Add the trout fillet to the skillet, skin side up, and sear for 2-3 minutes.
5. Flip the trout over and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until cooked through.
6. While the trout is cooking, heat the ground almonds and diced prunes in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly.
7. Add the apricot jam and amlou to the saucepan, stirring to combine.
8. Simmer the sauce for 2-3 minutes, or until heated through.
9. To serve, place the cooked trout on a plate and spoon the amlou sauce over the top.
10. Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
